name: Smith Machine Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the low Smith bar over your midfoot.
Hinge, bend your knees and grip the bar just outside your legs, then brace your trunk before releasing the hooks.
Drive powerfully through your feet to extend your hips and knees together until you stand upright with shoulders stacked over your hips.
Hinge back at your hips and bend your knees smoothly to lower the bar under control along the rails.
tips: Keep the bar gliding close against your shins and thighs without rounding your lower back.
Stand tall by squeezing your glutes at lockout rather than leaning backward.
